snippet.title: How Gary Oldman Became The Best Movie Villain
snippet.description:
🎭 Gary Oldman can go from calm to completely terrifying in a heartbeat.
It’s not CGI. It’s not editing. It’s a classic acting trick he picked up from the legendary James Cagney — and it’s pure genius.

This one-second transformation into evil is all about presence, precision, and a deep understanding of human psychology. Watching him flip that internal switch is like witnessing magic… or madness.

As an actor, moments like this remind me why I love this craft.
It’s not just about lines — it’s about energy, intention, and impact.
Oldman nails it every time.

🎬 Who’s YOUR favorite actor when it comes to playing the villain? Let’s talk performances that gave you goosebumps (in a good way).

snippet.title: RoboCop interviews: Joel Kinnaman and Gary Oldman talk politics and bad movies
snippet.description:
Watch the RoboCop World Premiere: http://bit.ly/1gfAdvo
Subscribe to TheShowbiz411! http://bit.ly/1dXOPuV
Stars of RoboCop, Joel Kinnaman, Gary Oldman and Abbie Cornish, have revealed the challenges and political meaning behind the remake of the 80's classic. Kinnaman, who plays the title role said that he found the scene where his character discovers he's been badly burnt in a car bomb difficult to film: "It was such an emotionally demanding scene, a complete existential anxiety... it was quite difficult." Meanwhile Gary Oldman says the film is much more than an action movie: "We have the debate of security versus liberty, freedom of choice, the debate of drones and robots. They're very topical, they're very current." Report by Lauren Hood.

snippet.title: Remember When Bad Guys Had DEPTH In Movies? #shorts
snippet.description:
Remember when bad guys had depth to them in Action movies? Take Gary Oldman here in 'Air Force One' (1997). Keith and Seamus discuss how his character has genuinely plausible motivation as well as justifiable motives for the terrible things he does throughout the film. Bring back this kind of villain in today's cinema!

snippet.title: Gary Oldman is a DWARF - Tiptoes Review - So Bad It's Good
snippet.description:
What do you get if you take three bonafide Oscar winners (Gary Oldman, Matthew McConaughey & Patricia Arquette) and team them up in a movie stacked with even more talent (Peter Dinklage and Kate Beckinsale) and then throw in some studio interference, questionable choices and a director having a meltdown….

Tiptoes, a hot mess! - well intentioned for sure, but awfully executed - so potentially perfect for another So Bad Its Good!

Enjoy!
